finding.text: The task folder has no `task.jsonl` and no `log` lines, so requirement 2 (say which file and line make the button, and why it shows on the error screen) is unmet. The cause appears only in a code comment in the diff (`ext/drawer/menu.js:25` makes the ✦ `.drawer-menu`), which a fresh agent cannot find from the folder.

Only `shots/before-390.png` and `shots/after-390.png` exist. Requirements 1 and 4 ask for 400 and 1200 wide on both `/live/no-such-page-xyz/` and `/framework/no-such/`, and the folder has no 1200 shots.

The fix is wrapped in `@media (max-width: 52em)` (`ext/drawer/drawer.css`, the changed rule), so at 1200 wide the ✦ button still shows on the error screen. If the owner's stale button also appears on desktop, it is not removed. The task folder does not say whether that case was checked.

The button is hidden, not removed, and nothing in the task shows it is the "older dictate" the owner meant. `menu.js:25` is the ✦ that opens the AI/Debug drawer, and the drawer readme calls it the AI button. The folder should record how that identification was made, and whether the "launches an older dictate" behaviour was confirmed by pressing it.

The module readmes were not updated, and requirement 3 says to update the readme of every touched module in the same commit. Neither `core/App/readme.md` nor `core/App/doc/error-page.md` mentions `app-error`. Neither `ext/drawer/readme.md` nor `ext/drawer/doc/decisions.md` mentions that the ✦ button is hidden on the error screen.

The branch name, the commit hash and the smoke result (`node Server/smoke.mjs`, no FAIL) are not recorded anywhere in the folder. The diff is on `compliance/dev`, which is not the `error-button` worktree. Requirement 5 asks for the branch, the commit and the two shots to be reported, so a fresh agent cannot continue from this folder alone.

`this.$app?.ac("app-error")` in `core/App/App.js:84` is never removed. If a later route change recovers and renders a page, the ✦ button stays hidden on mobile unless `$pages` or `$app` is rebuilt. Check whether recovery is possible without a reload.

A simpler fix may exist. The drawer could hide the button whenever no `.page` other than the error page is mounted, which would avoid adding a class in `App.js`. The current two-file change is small, so this is only worth a look.
